gaps.statement: The referenced Shadertoy page scySRd could not be retrieved (HTTP 403; no accessible mirror). Its source text, title, behavior, and assets are unverified.
gaps.impact: Prevents code-level attribution and any comparison to the referenced implementation.
gaps.mitigation: Clean-room implementation: formula, constants, palette, camera, and timing authored for Fractal Forge. Source-contract tests forbid samplers and assert original construction helpers.

gaps.statement: The visual lead's license is unknown and unknown licensing grants no reusable-source rights.
gaps.impact: No shader text, constants, media, or palettes may be copied from the lead.
gaps.mitigation: Observation-only policy recorded in provenance.json; nothing was downloaded or translated.

gaps.statement: No systematic database search was run; rforge-style query/result artifacts are intentionally absent.
gaps.impact: Coverage of academic glow/raymarching literature is incomplete.
gaps.mitigation: Authoritative sphere-tracing and SDF references are cited for the construction that was actually used.

gaps.statement: Host renders prove correctness but not mobile GPU cost.
gaps.impact: Frame-time on Waydroid/x86_64 is unproven by this package.
gaps.mitigation: Bounded loops (<= 180 march steps, <= 9 fold levels) and the release gate cover device behavior.
